assets.name: 疏叶细草
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW independent transparent PNG plant sprite as a sibling variation of the attached plant artwork. The input is a STYLE and PALETTE reference: match angular painterly gouache brush strokes, faceted color planes, sage/olive foliage and muted teal shadows, warm upper-left light, no smooth vector or photoreal look. Change the silhouette and branching substantially to break repetition when scattered in a 2D website meadow. Fixed front/slight three-quarter viewpoint, complete connected plant with base at bottom center. True transparent alpha outside the plant AND between leaves and stems. Keep all tips visible with 10% margin. Opaque paint inside plant; no atmospheric halo, glow, ground, pot, soil, cast shadow, checkerboard, text, animals, insects. Around 1024px artwork. Subject: One sparse upright tuft of fine narrow meadow grass blades, about 9–13 blades of varied length. Three tall slender blades lean gently in different directions, the tallest bows LEFT; short blades fan out asymmetrically at base. NO seed heads. Many open gaps, no large central spear, not bilateral symmetry. Height about 1.7 times width. The narrower foliage must make an airy silhouette, with painted planes still readable.
